about.title: For me, code is more than just work — it’s how I turn ideas into something real.
about.subtitle:
I didn’t plan on becoming a developer. I discovered programming almost by accident, started out of curiosity, and somewhere along the way, that curiosity turned into a passion. 
 Today, I’m a Full-Stack Web Developer who enjoys building things from the ground up, solving problems, and understanding how everything works behind the screen.
I’m always experimenting, learning, and looking for better ways to build. Because for me, the best part of coding isn’t just finishing a project — it’s everything I learn while creating it.
